meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Spreaker's sign-up prompts and platform promos; blur or hide podcast covers; optional promo rows
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on the Spreaker home page with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Spreaker served the same HTML to both; the layout switches with Tailwind breakpoints. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on main content, Log in link and the audio element).

LIVE: `a[href*="/signup"]` 5, left-menu links to /our-platform, /podcast-app, /spreaker-create, /prime 1 each, `img[alt="Podcast Cover"]` 161 (English-only alt text; locale-dependent), `.flex-end.mb-2:has(a[href$="/discover/prime"])` 1 and the Supporters Club header 1 (each with its following content div), `a[href*="/category/"]` 19. The original cookie rule matched 2 OneTrust elements; ad and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Podcast covers Show/Blur/Hide.

Spreaker is built with Tailwind utility classes and no data attributes, so rules rely on href patterns, the image alt text and the readable utility pair `flex-end mb-2` that wraps a row header. If Spreaker rewrites its markup the row rules may stop matching.

NOT verified: podcast and episode pages, the Prime Network pages, the player, logged-in pages, the 'Your Podcasts' link target after redirect, other languages (alt text and path names).
